license_note: The LICENSE file sits beside the weights and is the governing document; the M3 GitHub repository carries code and documentation but no license file of its own. The MiniMax Community License permits non-commercial use, requires commercial products and services to display 'Built with MiniMax M3', and requires separate prior written authorization above 20 million US dollars in yearly revenue — a one-time notice suffices below that line — so the release is source-available.
